Apply Today!
Join a purpose-driven university with more than 85 areas of study and more than $140 million in aid and scholarships awarded each year. Apply today. We’re ready to help you find your purpose.
Choose the application that’s right for you:
First-year freshman applicants: Apply through the ApplyTexas or Common Application.
All other applicants: Apply through ApplyTexas.
Need assistance? Our Admissions Counselors are here to provide advice and guidance throughout the application process.
Apply with ApplyTexas
Apply with Common App
How to find TAMU-CC on ApplyTexas
Go to ApplyTexas and create your free account or login if you already have an account created.
Navigate to the top site menu (or click the 3-line icon at the top of the page) and select School Search.
Under Start Semester, select which semester and year you are applying to start attending TAMU-CC.
Under Application Type, select the type you are applying as (ex. Undergraduate, Transfer, Graduate, etc.).
For School, type in Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi and select our university name in the results that display.
The application the application for you should display in the results. Select View Details to start your application or view additional information, like deadlines and application fees.
How to find TAMU-CC on Common App
Create an Account
Go to the official Common App Website and select "Create an account".
Choose First-year student
Enter your email address, create a password, and verify your account.
Search and Add Colleges
Go to the College Search tab to find schools that accept the Common App.
Click the "Add" button next to Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi and save it to your My Colleges list
Review the unique requirements, deadlines, and fee details under the My Colleges tab.
Fill Out the "Common App" Tab
Complete the core sections under the Common App tab.
Complete College-Specific Supplements
Open the My Colleges section to answer any additional questions or supplemental essays required by individual schools.
Request that your high school send your official transcript.
